alias: Planes: log people of interest overhead
description: Writes each person of interest's aircraft that comes into the area to the logbook (sensor.plane_details), so who flew over today can be looked up. The Plane details integration fires plane_details_notable once per visit, from adsb.lol's 6 nm circle and plane-alert-db's list (celebrities' and billionaires' jets, VIPs, governments). Ty, 2026-11-03.

data.name: Notable plane
data.message: {{ p.notable_name }} ({{ p.notable_category }}): {{ p.registration or p.hex }}{{ ' ' ~ p.type if p.type }}{{ ', ' ~ p.callsign if p.callsign }}{{ ', owned by ' ~ p.owner if p.owner and p.owner != p.notable_name }}{{ ', ' ~ ((p.distance | float(0)) * 0.621371) | round(1) ~ ' mi away' if p.distance is not none }}{{ ' at ' ~ '{:,}'.format(p.altitude | int) ~ ' ft' if p.altitude is number }}
